name: See every store Hubit sources from
description: The Stores page lists the 28 shops with what they sell, their platform, product counts and when each was last read.

planSteps.description: Open the home page of this site and click 'Stores' in the header
Verify the heading reads '28 stores' and the text says '28 of 28 answered at their last reading.' Headings are displayed in capitals by the stylesheet; compare text without regard to case.
Verify the table has the columns Store, Sells, Runs on, Products on Hubit, Ships from, Last read and Status, and 28 store rows
Verify the Allbirds row reads Footwear, Shopify, 40, US, '23 Oct 2026', Answered
Verify the Nalgene row reads Outdoor, WooCommerce, 40, US and the JOCO Cups row reads Kitchen, WooCommerce, 39, AU
Verify a search for 'Nalgene' opens with Nalgene products
